svg.text: ONE CHAT TURN · RETRIEVE FIRST, THEN LET THE MODEL SPEAK
the first call of every turn
LLM · the model never writes Cypher
search_facts(keywords) — for questions that name nobody

the same lookups, run by code

then the character gate: only what {name} knows (PERCEIVES edges)
every tool result and the pack pass through both gates
spoilers moves the story's clock, not who knows what
the committed queries as typed tools · the API binds the parameters
run folder: knowledge-pack.txt · chat.jsonl · calls.jsonl · cost.json
names the reader has not read yet
spoilers off: the alias with the smallest
TWO SWITCHES, BOTH ON BY DEFAULT
Without them the model answered some turns
without a tool and invented details from the
novel. With both on, every turn called a tool.
Knowledge gate v1: reveal time; per-character
The prompt is a built-in template with no facts about the novel (a test checks it carries
no proper name but the character's), a register line per book, a voice card and a few of
the character's own lines (at most 1,800 characters), and the length rule last.
